sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "calendars" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_value" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shift_types" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_value" INTEGER NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_minute" INTEGER NULL CHECK("start_minute" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), "end_minute" INTEGER NULL CHECK("end_minute" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), "paid_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "night_override" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("night_override" IN (0, 1)), "hourly_rate_cents" INTEGER NULL, "fixed_plus_cents" INTEGER NULL CHECK("fixed_plus_cents" BETWEEN 0 AND 999999999), "icon" TEXT NULL, "alarm_sound" TEXT NULL CHECK("alarm_sound" IS NULL OR NOT ("alarm_sound" = '')), "segment2_start_minute" INTEGER NULL, "segment2_duration_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "location" TEXT NULL CHECK("location" IS NULL OR LENGTH(TRIM("location")) > 0 AND LENGTH("location") <= 200), "night_plus_cents_per_hour" INTEGER NULL CHECK("night_plus_cents_per_hour" BETWEEN 0 AND 999999999), "holiday_plus_cents_per_hour" INTEGER NULL CHECK("holiday_plus_cents_per_hour" BETWEEN 0 AND 999999999), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ((start_minute IS NULL) = (end_minute IS NULL)), CHECK ((segment2_start_minute IS NULL) = (segment2_duration_minutes IS NULL)), CHECK (segment2_start_minute IS NULL OR start_minute IS NOT NULL), CHECK (segment2_start_minute IS NULL OR segment2_start_minute BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), CHECK (segment2_duration_minutes IS NULL OR segment2_duration_minutes BETWEEN 1 AND 1440));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shift_type_versions" ("shift_type_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shift_types (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "until_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_minute" INTEGER NULL CHECK("start_minute" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), "end_minute" INTEGER NULL CHECK("end_minute" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), "paid_minutes" INTEGER NULL CHECK("paid_minutes" >= 0), "night_override" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("night_override" IN (0, 1)), "hourly_rate_cents" INTEGER NULL CHECK("hourly_rate_cents" BETWEEN 0 AND 999999999), "fixed_plus_cents" INTEGER NULL CHECK("fixed_plus_cents" BETWEEN 0 AND 999999999), "segment2_start_minute" INTEGER NULL, "segment2_duration_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "night_plus_cents_per_hour" INTEGER NULL CHECK("night_plus_cents_per_hour" BETWEEN 0 AND 999999999), "holiday_plus_cents_per_hour" INTEGER NULL CHECK("holiday_plus_cents_per_hour" BETWEEN 0 AND 999999999), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("shift_type_id", "until_date"), CHECK ((start_minute IS NULL) = (end_minute IS NULL)), CHECK ((segment2_start_minute IS NULL) = (segment2_duration_minutes IS NULL)), CHECK (segment2_start_minute IS NULL OR start_minute IS NOT NULL), CHECK (segment2_start_minute IS NULL OR segment2_start_minute BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), CHECK (segment2_duration_minutes IS NULL OR segment2_duration_minutes BETWEEN 1 AND 1440));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "patterns" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "steps" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (steps <> '[]'));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pattern_runs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "calendar_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES calendars (id), "pattern_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES patterns (id), "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NULL, "step_offset" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= start_date));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "day_entries" ("calendar_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES calendars (id), "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "shift_type_ids" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note_reminder_minute" INTEGER NULL CHECK("note_reminder_minute" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), "overtime_minutes" INTEGER NULL CHECK("overtime_minutes" >= 0), "early_leave_minutes" INTEGER NULL CHECK("early_leave_minutes" >= 0), "extra_amount_cents" INTEGER NULL CHECK("extra_amount_cents" BETWEEN -999999999 AND 999999999), PRIMARY KEY ("calendar_id", "date"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "note_attachments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "calendar_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES calendars (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "relative_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (kind IN ('photo', 'file', 'sketch')), UNIQUE (relative_path COLLATE NOCASE), CHECK (length(id) BETWEEN 1 AND 64), CHECK (length(relative_path) BETWEEN 1 AND 512 AND substr(relative_path, 1, 1) NOT IN ('/', '.') AND instr(relative_path, '..') = 0 AND instr(relative_path, char(92)) = 0), CHECK (length(mime_type) BETWEEN 1 AND 255), CHECK (size_bytes BETWEEN 0 AND 52428800), CHECK (length(sha256) = 64), CHECK (display_name IS NULL OR length(display_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 255));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "day_tasks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "calendar_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES calendars (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "done" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("done" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (id <> ''), CHECK (trim(title) <> '' AND length(title) <= 500));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shift_swaps" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "calendar_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES calendars (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "colleague" TEXT NOT NULL, "direction" TEXT NOT NULL, "given_shift_type_ids" TEXT NULL, "received_shift_type_ids" TEXT NULL, "return_date" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "closed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (id <> ''), CHECK (direction IN ('theyOwe', 'iOwe')), CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'returned')), CHECK (trim(colleague) <> '' AND length(colleague) <= 200), CHECK (note IS NULL OR length(note) <= 2000), CHECK ((status = 'returned') = (closed_at IS NOT NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "holidays" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "scope" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "region_code" TEXT NULL, "municipality_code" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "absence_balances" ("year" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "allowed_days" REAL NOT NULL, "calendar_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES calendars (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NULL, "period_start" TEXT NULL, "period_end" TEXT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'day', "shift_type_quarters" TEXT NULL, "carry_over" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("carry_over" IN (0, 1)), "carry_over_max_days" REAL NULL, "adjustment_days" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("year", "type"), CHECK (unit IN ('day', 'half', 'quarter')), CHECK (name IS NULL OR (trim(name) <> '' AND length(name) <= 100)), CHECK ((period_start IS NULL) = (period_end IS NULL)), CHECK (period_end IS NULL OR period_end >= period_start), CHECK (carry_over_max_days IS NULL OR (carry_over_max_days >= 0 AND carry_over_max_days * 4 = CAST(carry_over_max_days * 4 AS INTEGER))), CHECK (adjustment_days * 4 = CAST(adjustment_days * 4 AS INTEGER)));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE INDEX idx_note_attachments_day ON note_attachments (calendar_id, date)
CREATE INDEX idx_day_tasks_day ON day_tasks (calendar_id, date)
CREATE INDEX idx_shift_swaps_day ON shift_swaps (calendar_id, date)
